hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: EulerSwap is a custom curve AMM hook that replaces Uniswap v4 concentrated liquidity with its own bonding curve, routing swaps through Euler lending vaults. In beforeSwap, it computes quotes, takes input tokens into and withdraws output tokens from Euler vaults, and settles accounting with the PoolManager via beforeSwapReturnsDelta.
